reader_summary.overview: Today, we are breaking down the food catering giant Compass Group. Whether it's your corporate cafeteria, the food stands at a sporting event, or the old hospital food tray, the food services industry is all around you. Compass is the giant in this space, with a history that dates back to the emergence of this outsourced trend.

key_points.text: My guest is Asif Jeevanjee, Chief Executive of Oakmount Capital.
Asif talks through both the business and the sector.
What do contracts typically look like?
